scope: R1 local performance measurements; this artifact does not assert CI success.
timingNotes: Wall time is elapsed smoke time. Per-stage and execution sums overlap under concurrency. Resource sampling can miss short-lived peaks and includes any other replaykit.run-labeled containers.
comparisonNotes: No speedup is inferred automatically. Compare identical image IDs, candidate hash, repeat counts, and measurement conditions before attributing a runtime change to concurrency.
